info.title: pre.dev AI Gateway API
info.description:
One OpenAI-compatible API for hundreds of models from every major lab, paid for in pre.dev credits.

- **Base URL:** `https://api.pre.dev/v1` for the OpenAI SDKs. The Anthropic SDKs take `https://api.pre.dev` and add `/v1/messages` themselves.
- **Auth:** the workspace API key (`pdk_…`) from Integrations → Built-in in the pre.dev dashboard, as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key`. Keep it on a server: it spends the workspace's credits.
- **Models:** send ids exactly as `GET /v1/models` lists them, such as `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`.
- **Public directory:** `GET /v1/models/public` lists every model with no key and no prices.
- **Charges:** each call is charged in credits from its metered cost. Non-streaming responses report the charge in `x-predev-credits-charged`; `GET /v1/generation` reports it for any call. A request is refused with `402` before it runs when the balance cannot cover it. Catalog, usage, generation and file reads are free.
- **Limits:** 600 requests per minute per workspace, 30 on the free trial. A free workspace can spend 5 credits on AI calls in total, then gets `402 subscription_required`. Reads do not count toward the per-minute limit.
- **Errors:** errors raised by pre.dev use the OpenAI error shape with a `predev` object (`GatewayError`). Errors from the model keep their HTTP status and message (`ModelError`). Every inference response carries `x-predev-request-id`.
- **Streaming:** `stream: true` returns server-sent events in the native format of each endpoint. Lines that start with `:` are keep-alives.

Example values are illustrative.

post.description:
Runs a chat completion in the OpenAI format on any chat model in the catalog. Point an OpenAI SDK at `https://api.pre.dev/v1` and pass the pre.dev key.

Standard fields such as `temperature`, `stop`, `seed`, `tools` and `response_format` work as in the OpenAI API. A `provider` object is removed before the request runs: choose a model, and use `models` for fallbacks.

With `stream: true` the response is `text/event-stream`. Lines that start with `:` are keep-alive comments; ignore them. Credits settle when the stream ends, so streamed responses carry `x-predev-request-id` but not the credits headers; `GET /v1/generation?id=<id>` reports the charge afterwards. If the client disconnects, generation stops shortly after and the call is charged for what the model produced.

messages.content: Summarize the plot of Dune in two sentences.

200.description: The completion. With `stream: true`, server-sent chunks in the OpenAI format ending with `data: [DONE]`.

message.content: Sunlight scatters off air molecules, and blue light scatters the most.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --fail-with-body https://api.pre.dev/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREDEV_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5","max_tokens":200,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Answer in one sentence."},{"role":"user","content":"Why is the sky blue?"}]}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python (OpenAI SDK)
x-codeSamples.source:
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.pre.dev/v1", api_key=os.environ["PREDEV_API_KEY"])

completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="anthropic/claude-sonnet-5",
    max_tokens=200,
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "Answer in one sentence."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Why is the sky blue?"},
    ],
)
print(completion.choices[0].message.content)

post.description:
Runs a request in the OpenAI Responses format. Each request stands alone: responses are not stored, so send the full conversation in `input` rather than `previous_response_id`.

With `stream: true` the response is `text/event-stream`. Lines that start with `:` are keep-alive comments; ignore them. Credits settle when the stream ends, so streamed responses carry `x-predev-request-id` but not the credits headers; `GET /v1/generation?id=<id>` reports the charge afterwards. If the client disconnects, generation stops shortly after and the call is charged for what the model produced. Streams use the Responses event format (`response.created`, `response.output_text.delta`, `response.completed`, and so on).

example.input: Write a one-line release note for a faster login page.

200.description: The response object, or Responses API events when `stream` is true.

content.text: Login is now twice as fast.

post.description:
Runs a request in the Anthropic Messages format, for the Anthropic SDKs. Set the SDK base URL to `https://api.pre.dev` (the SDK adds `/v1/messages`) and pass the pre.dev key; the SDK's `x-api-key` header is accepted. The `anthropic-version` header is optional.

Use catalog ids such as `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`. Any chat model in the catalog works through this format, not only Anthropic models.

With `stream: true` the response is `text/event-stream`. Lines that start with `:` are keep-alive comments; ignore them. Credits settle when the stream ends, so streamed responses carry `x-predev-request-id` but not the credits headers; `GET /v1/generation?id=<id>` reports the charge afterwards. If the client disconnects, generation stops shortly after and the call is charged for what the model produced. Streams use the Anthropic event format (`message_start`, `content_block_delta`, `message_delta`, `message_stop`).

messages.content: Give me a haiku about deploys.

200.description: The message, or Anthropic-style server-sent events when `stream` is true.

content.text:
Green checks line up
The pipeline hums, then goes quiet
Production wakes up

from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic(base_url="https://api.pre.dev", api_key=os.environ["PREDEV_API_KEY"])

    model="anthropic/claude-sonnet-5",
    max_tokens=256,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Give me a haiku about deploys."}],

print(message.content[0].text)

post.description:
Starts an asynchronous video job. Submitting needs a balance of at least 10 credits.

1. `POST /v1/videos` returns the job with `status: "pending"` and a `polling_url`.
2. Poll `polling_url` (`GET /v1/videos/{jobId}`) every few seconds until `status` is `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `expired`.
3. Download the video from `GET /v1/videos/{jobId}/content`.

The job is charged once, when it finishes: on the first poll that reports completion, on the download if you never polled, or by pre.dev shortly after if you stopped polling.

example.prompt: A paper boat drifting down a rain gutter

x-codeSamples.label: cURL (submit, poll, download)
x-codeSamples.source:
JOB=$(curl --fail-with-body -s https://api.pre.dev/v1/videos \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREDEV_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "bytedance/seedance-2.0-mini", "prompt": "A paper boat drifting down a rain gutter", "duration": 5}')
POLL=$(echo "$JOB" | jq -r .polling_url)

while :; do
  STATUS=$(curl --fail-with-body -s "$POLL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREDEV_API_KEY" | jq -r .status)
  case "$STATUS" in completed|failed|cancelled|expired) break ;; esac
  sleep 5
done

curl --fail-with-body "$POLL/content" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREDEV_API_KEY" -o video.mp4

get.description: Reports a video job's status. Use the job id from the submit response's `polling_url`. The poll that first sees the job finish charges it and returns `x-predev-credits-charged`. Jobs belong to the workspace that submitted them.

get.description: Streams the finished video. Call it after the job reports `completed`; before that it returns an error status. A download settles the job's charge if no poll has yet.

post.description: Turns text into speech, or a prompt into music, in the OpenAI speech format, so `client.audio.speech.create()` works unchanged. Speech models return WAV (24 kHz mono) by default, or raw PCM16 with `response_format: "pcm16"`. Music models (`google/lyria-3-clip-preview`, `google/lyria-3-pro-preview`) return MP3. The `x-predev-audio-format` header names the format. A request needs a balance of at least 1 credit.

value.input: Upbeat lo-fi for a launch video

200.description: The audio: `audio/wav` for speech, `audio/mpeg` for music, or `application/octet-stream` with raw PCM16 samples (24 kHz mono) when `response_format` is `pcm16`.

400.description: `model` or `input` is missing, the model does not produce audio, or the body is not valid JSON.

error.message: `model` and `input` (the text to speak, or the music prompt) are required.

get.description: Lists every chat, audio and embedding model you can call, each with a `predev` object of credit prices. Free, and not counted against the rate limit. The catalog refreshes every 15 minutes, so a model released since the last refresh can be callable before it is listed. Query parameters are ignored.

Every model an app can call, with its lab, type and modalities, and no prices. Needs no API key, so a page can show the catalog. Credit prices are on `GET /v1/models`. Responses can be cached for 10 minutes; send the `ETag` back in `If-None-Match` to get `304` when nothing changed.

model_error.summary: The model returned a non-JSON error

error.message: The model provider returned an error (HTTP 502)

BalanceUnavailable.description: The credit balance could not be read, so nothing ran. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

error.message: Could not read this workspace's credit balance. Retry shortly.

GatewayError.description: An error raised by pre.dev, in the OpenAI error shape with an extra `predev` object. Branch on `error.code`.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

type.description: Error class. The OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs map the HTTP status to their own exception types.

code.description:
| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `missing_api_key` | 401 | No `Authorization: Bearer` or `x-api-key` header. |
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | The key is unknown, or was rotated more than 15 minutes ago. |
| `too_many_auth_failures` | 429 | More than 30 failed key attempts from this IP address in a minute. |
| `insufficient_credits` | 402 | The balance is zero or below the estimate for this request. Nothing ran. |
| `subscription_required` | 402 | A free workspace used its 5 credits of AI calls. |
| `rate_limit_exceeded` | 429 | Over the per-minute request limit for the workspace. |
| `balance_unavailable` | 503 | The balance could not be read. Nothing ran. |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | `/v1/audio/speech` is missing `model` or `input`, or the model does not produce audio. |
| `missing_id` | 400 | `/v1/generation` was called without `id`. |
| `not_found` | 404 | Unknown path, or a file, video job or generation that belongs to another workspace. |
| `not_ready` | 404 or 502 | Generation stats are not available yet. |
| `upstream_unavailable` | 502 | The model did not answer, or returned no audio. |
| `catalog_unavailable` | 503 | `GET /v1/models/public` while the catalog refreshes. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Unexpected error. |

GatewayErrorDetails.description: Extra fields for some error codes; an empty object for the rest.

estimated_credits.description: Estimated credits the request needs. Sent with `insufficient_credits`.

trial_credits_used.description: Credits the free trial has spent on AI calls. Sent with `subscription_required`.

topup_url.description: Where to add credits or subscribe.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait. Also sent as the `Retry-After` header.

available_models.description: Speech and music model ids. Sent with `invalid_request` from `/v1/audio/speech`.

ModelError.description: An error returned by the model for this request. The HTTP status is the model's own; `code` usually repeats it.

raw.description: The model's own error text, when it adds detail.

reasons.description: Moderation categories when the input was flagged.

flagged_input.description: The part of the input that was flagged.

InvalidJsonBody.description: The request body is not valid JSON. Checked before authentication.

ContentPart.description: One part of a message. Common types: `text`, `image_url` (an https or base64 data URL), `file` (a URL, a base64 data URL, or a `file_id` from `POST /v1/files`), and `input_audio` (base64 audio with its format).

file_data.description: A URL or a base64 data URL.

content.description: Text, or an array of content parts for images, files and audio.

tool_call_id.description: On `tool` messages: the id of the call this message answers.

ResponseFormat.description: Ask for JSON. `json_schema` enforces a schema on models whose catalog row lists `structured_outputs` in `supported_parameters`.

ReasoningOptions.description: Reasoning controls for models that support them. Reasoning tokens count as output tokens.

max_tokens.description: Token budget for reasoning, on models that accept one.

exclude.description: Reason without returning the reasoning text.

Plugin.description: An extra capability for this call: `web` adds web search results, `file-parser` reads PDFs for models without native document input, `response-healing` repairs malformed JSON output, and `context-compression` shortens prompts that exceed the context window.

model.description: A model id exactly as listed by `GET /v1/models`. Required unless you send `models`.

models.description: Fallback model ids, tried in order until one serves the request. The response `model` names the model that answered, and the charge follows that model.

stream.description: Return server-sent events. The final chunk before `data: [DONE]` carries `usage`.

stream_options.description: Optional. pre.dev turns `include_usage` on for every stream.

modalities.description: Output modalities, for models that can return images or audio.

session_id.description: Groups related requests, such as one conversation.

user.description: Your id for the end user. pre.dev prefixes it with a hash of your workspace.

model.description: The model that served the call.

reasoning.description: Reasoning text, on models that return it.

TokenUsage.description: Token counts for the call. Charges are reported in credits by the `x-predev-credits-charged` header and `GET /v1/generation`.

input.description: A string, or an array of input items (messages, function call outputs, and so on). Send the whole conversation: responses are not stored, and `previous_response_id` is not supported.

output.description: Output items: messages with `output_text` parts, reasoning, and function calls.

output_text.description: The concatenated text output, when present.

model.description: A catalog id such as `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`, not a native Anthropic model name. Any chat model in the catalog works.

thinking.description: Extended thinking, on models that support it.

input.description: Text to embed, or an array of texts. Multimodal models also take content objects.

dimensions.description: Output size, on models that support it.

input_type.description: For models that distinguish queries from documents, for example `search_query` or `search_document`.

embedding.description: Floats, or a base64 string when `encoding_format` is `base64`.

model.description: A rerank model id. Rerank models are not listed by the catalog endpoints.

top_n.description: Return only the most relevant documents.

results.description: Sorted by relevance, most relevant first.

index.description: Position of the document in your `documents` array.

n.description: Upper bound on images; a model can return fewer.

size.description: A tier such as `2K`, or exact pixels such as `1024x1024`.

stream.description: Stream partial images, on models whose catalog row has `supports_streaming: true`.

prompt.description: What to generate. Optional for models that work from images alone.

frame_images.description: First or last frame images, on models that list `supported_frame_images`.

input_references.description: Reference images, audio or video, on models that accept them.

polling_url.description: `https://api.pre.dev/v1/videos/{jobId}` for this job. Poll this URL with your key.

unsigned_urls.description: Present when the job has completed. Download through `GET /v1/videos/{jobId}/content`.

model.description: A catalog model whose `architecture.output_modalities` includes `audio`: speech models (`openai/gpt-audio-mini`, `openai/gpt-audio`) or music models (`google/lyria-3-clip-preview`, `google/lyria-3-pro-preview`).

input.description: The text to speak, or for a music model, the style or mood to compose.

voice.description: Speech voice, such as `alloy`, `ash`, `ballad`, `coral`, `echo`, `sage`, `shimmer` or `verse`. Music models ignore it.

instructions.description: How to deliver the text. By default the text is read verbatim. Music models ignore it.

response_format.description: `wav` (24 kHz mono) or `pcm16` (raw samples; `pcm` also works). Other values return WAV. Music models return their own container (MP3).

file.description: The audio file. The format comes from the filename extension or the part's content type.

model.description: A transcription model id, such as `openai/whisper-large-v3`. Transcription models are not listed by the catalog endpoints.

file.description: Up to 60 MB. PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, or UTF-8 text. The type is read from the contents.

purpose.description: Sent by the OpenAI SDKs, for example `user_data`.

File.description: File metadata. `id` and `filename` are always present. The other fields follow one of two styles: `object: "file"`, `bytes`, `purpose` and a Unix `created_at`, or `type: "file"`, `size_bytes`, `mime_type`, `downloadable` and an ISO `created_at`.

id.description: Use it in a `file` content part as `file_id`.

FileDeleted.description: Deletion result: `{ id, object: "file", deleted: true }` in the OpenAI style, or `{ id, type: "file_deleted" }`.

CreditPrices.description: Credit prices for the model. Charges are computed from each call's metered cost; these rates let you estimate.

credits_per_m_input.description: Credits per million input tokens. `null` when the model is not priced per token.

credits_per_m_output.description: Credits per million output tokens. `null` when the model is not priced per token.

credits_per_m_cache_read.description: Credits per million cached input tokens read.

credits_per_m_cache_write.description: Credits per million tokens written to the cache.

credits_per_image.description: On chat model rows, per input image. On image model rows, per generated image.

credits_per_request.description: Per request, for models with a per-request price.

credits_per_second_output.description: Video models: per second of generated video. The base rate, or the lowest across resolutions and modes.

credits_per_m_video_tokens.description: Video models priced by video tokens.

credits_per_m_output_image_tokens.description: Image models priced by output image tokens.

billables.description: Image models: every priced component and its unit.

Model.description: A model row. Fields other than the ones listed here describe the model (limits, default parameters, and so on) and vary by modality.

supported_parameters.description: Request parameters the model accepts. A list of names on chat and embedding rows; an object of parameter ranges on image rows.

total_count.description: Number of rows in `data`, on listings that report it.

updated_at.description: When the catalog behind this list was last refreshed.

labs.description: Labs by number of models, most first.

workspace.description: The workspace the key belongs to (a personal account or a team).

project.description: The project from `x-predev-project-id` when the workspace owns it, else `null`. The totals always cover the whole workspace.

credits_remaining.description: Current balance. `null` on plans without a credit limit.

by_model.description: One row per model and endpoint, most credits first.

model.description: The model that served the calls; `null` when none answered.

errors.description: Calls that returned HTTP 400 or higher.

native_tokens_prompt.description: Counted by the model's own tokenizer.
